Name: Returning Player Experience Survey
ActivityDes:
Requirements: Commandant Lv.40

Event Info:
In order to create a better gaming environment, the Command Central has decided to conduct a survey regarding the in-game experiences of returning players. Please tap the [Advance] button below to share your thoughts! Rewards will be granted upon completion of the survey.

Name: Return Support
ActivityDes: During the event, Commandants in the "Return" state can complete the missions and get the rewards (the event ends when the Return state expires).

Name: Homecoming Voyage
ActivityDes: Event Info: Play through the new story [Homecoming Voyage] and complete missions.

Name: Simulated Battlefield
ActivityDes:
Requirements:
Commandant Lv.16.
Mission Info:
1. Earn Simulation Scores upon clearing a stage.
2. Spend Simulation Scores to purchase items at the Simulation Shop.
3. The limited-time shop exchange ends on July 16, 2026, at 23:00 (UTC).
4. During the event period, clear Simulated Battlefield stages and consume a certain amount of serum to claim rewards.

Name: Retro Arcade
ActivityDes:
Requirements:
Commandant Lv.40.
Event Info:
1. During the event, three game modes will be available simultaneously: Fluffy Snooze, Wreck-It Shark-speare, and Cat Grab.
2. In Fluffy Snooze, you need to merge target blocks as quickly as possible to eliminate numbered blocks in the clearing area.
3. In Wreck-It Shark-speare, you need to clear blocks from below as much as possible to prevent them from reaching the top.
4. In Cat Grab, you need to obtain more Resource Points in stages with progressively shorter time limits by using modifications and upgrades.
5. Participate in the event and complete missions to obtain [Retro Modules], which can be exchanged for items in the Exchange Shop.

Name: Rapid Pursuit
ActivityDes:
Requirements: Commandant Lv.42

Event Info:
1. This event features 4 stages, each with 4 difficulty levels.
2. Defeat Bosses of different difficulties in bounties with the required characters.
3. Complete bounty missions to claim rewards.

Name: Nebulous Vigil
ActivityDes:
Requirements:
Commandant Lv.40
Event Info:
1. There are a total of 6 difficulty levels, all of which are highly challenging with ["Vanguard"] being your formidable enemy.
2. All members will be reset once knocked out during the challenge, making the challenge easier to complete.
3. Each stage has its own 3-star clearance conditions. Collectibles will be rewarded once you have earned a total of 3 stars. The more stars you earn, the higher the quality of the collectibles will be.

Name: Shrouded Requiem
ActivityDes:
Requirements:
Commandant Lv.40.
Event Info:
1. [Shrouded Requiem] is a permanent mode with two parts: [Labyrinth Breakout] and [Nightshroud Tales].
2. In [Labyrinth Breakout], equip characters with skills and relics, then challenge powerful enemies to earn Sealed Writs, the currency used to unlock stories.
3. In [Nightshroud Tales], spend Sealed Writs to unlock character stories and challenge stages.
4. [Shrouded Requiem] includes both limited-time missions and permanent missions. Play [Labyrinth Breakout] or [Nightshroud Tales] to complete missions and earn permanent currency and limited-time currency rewards.
5. Spend permanent currency and limited-time currency in the corresponding shops to exchange for rewards such as [Stamps] and [R&D Tickets].
